description: (NH₄)₂NaGaF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight NH₄ clusters inside a NaGaF₆ framework. In each NH₄ cluster, N is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent H atoms. All N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. In the NaGaF₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.36 Å. Ga is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form GaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ga-F bond lengths are 1.93 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Ga atom.
